title: Deterministic polynomial GT BSGS with specialized instruction accounting

claims.statement: For the full protected fixed-G1 inversion problem, the deterministic algorithm in proof.md returns a valid G2 preimage for every valid challenge, success probability 1, with total cold classical computation at most 2^158 dense-Fp12 reference equivalents at C=20000. Peak memory is below 2^145 bytes; preprocessing below 2^158 reference equivalents is included in total; nonuniform advice is zero bytes. This is an analytical upper bound, not a practical production attack.
